title: Microsoft Advertising Campaign Management v13: POST https://campaign.api.bingads.microsoft.com/CampaignManagement/v13/OfflineConversions/Apply
description: Transcribed from learn.microsoft.com/en-us/advertising/campaign-management-service/applyofflineconversions and offlineconversion (view=bingads-13, fetched 2026-09-30): 'You can add a maximum of 1,000 offline conversions per service request.' ConversionTime must be UTC and 'within the last 90 days'; 'The MSCLKID is optional when you provide a hashed email address or phone number for enhanced conversions.' Headers CustomerId/CustomerAccountId are non-secret; Authorization and DeveloperToken are added by the live transport.

ConversionName.description: 'This name must match an existing conversion goal name'

ConversionTime.description: 'The value must be in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).'
